proposed.title: verify-mutation.mjs -- the RECORDED MUTATION token is accepted anywhere inside the check's fixed window around a test, so a token in a file header or in a neighbouring test's comment greens a test that carries no mutation of its own
proposed.summary: Noted by the custodian on 2026-09-17 beside the multi-line-attribute weakness while reading the check's window logic for the verify-quotes branch's e8a8661 fix: the token is matched by distance, not by ownership. Fix: require the token inside the test's own comment or attribute block (between the previous item's end and its fn), print a diagnostic for a token that owns no test; a fixture with a header token and a bare test, plus the recorded mutation. Five-line short form, single gate
